title: Sweet Crumbs Bakery
description: A warm, appetite-driving marketing site for a boutique bakery — a full-bleed drippy-cake hero leads into six cake categories (wedding, birthday, custom, cupcakes, pastries, seasonal specials), a featured-creations gallery with pricing on every card, a founder's-story section with real stats (10+ years, 15,000+ cakes made, 500+ wedding cakes), and customer testimonials.
designGoal: Make the menu feel tactile and craft-driven — big product photography, a warm cream-and-brown palette, and a path from hero to "Explore Our Menu" that never takes more than a click or two.

title: Jerai Fitness
description: A high-energy landing page for a fitness brand — bold hero with a running promo banner, animated member/trainer stats, four program cards (strength, cardio & HIIT, personal training, group classes), an interactive BMI calculator, and member testimonials with star ratings.
designGoal: Communicate intensity through motion and bold typography over a dark, high-contrast palette, while keeping the interactive BMI tool simple enough to use in one sitting.

title: Lumina Unisex Salon
description: An elegant booking-focused site for a unisex salon in Ahmedabad — grayscale interior photography with a gold accent, four service pillars (hair, skincare, grooming, spa & wellness), rotating promotional offers, a stylist team section, and a client gallery.
designGoal: Let a premium gold-on-black palette do the talking — restrained motion, real interior photography, and a "Book Appointment" CTA that's never more than a scroll away.

title: Anayra Creations
description: An image-forward showcase for a luxury jewellery brand — a full-bleed gold-and-shadow hero, six curated collections (bridal, necklaces, earrings, rings, gold, daily wear), a best-sellers grid with pricing and discount tags, a brand-heritage section with trust badges (BIS hallmarked, certified diamonds, lifetime exchange), patron testimonials, and a private-viewing appointment form.
designGoal: Let the jewellery photography carry the page — a dark, editorial palette, serif display type, and restrained motion, with the booking form kept just as polished as the product pages.
